# Renewable Energy Cost Revolution: LCOE, Capacity & Fossil Fuel Subsidies (2010–2024)

## Overview
This collection of four datasets tracks the economic transformation of the global energy sector from 2010 to 2024. It covers the declining levelized cost of energy for solar PV, onshore wind, and battery storage; the cost range of new fossil fuel generation; cumulative renewable installed capacity; and annual global fossil fuel subsidies.

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np
import json

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

lcoe = data['lcoe_trends']['data']
fossil = data['fossil_fuel_lcoe_range']['data']
capacity = data['installed_capacity']['data']

years_lcoe = [d['year'] for d in lcoe]
solar = [d['solar_pv'] for d in lcoe]
wind = [d['onshore_wind'] for d in lcoe]
battery = [d['battery_storage'] for d in lcoe]

years_fossil = [d['year'] for d in fossil]
gas_low = [d['gas_ccgt_low'] for d in fossil]
gas_high = [d['gas_ccgt_high'] for d in fossil]
coal_low = [d['coal_low'] for d in fossil]
coal_high = [d['coal_high'] for d in fossil]

years_cap = [d['year'] for d in capacity]
solar_gw = [d['solar_pv_gw'] for d in capacity]
wind_gw = [d['onshore_wind_gw'] for d in capacity]

years_sub = [d['year'] for d in subsidies]
total_sub = [d['total_subsidies_bn'] for d in subsidies]
consumption_sub = [d['consumption_subsidies_bn'] for d in subsidies]
production_sub = [d['production_subsidies_bn'] for d in subsidies]

# --- Colors: editorial palette ---
COL_SOLAR = '#E8690A'
COL_WIND = '#1B7F79'
COL_BATTERY = '#6A3D9A'
COL_GAS = '#B0B0B0'
COL_COAL = '#666666'
COL_SUBSIDY_CONS = '#C44E52'
COL_SUBSIDY_PROD = '#8C564B'
COL_SOLAR_CAP = '#F4A460'
COL_WIND_CAP = '#5DADE2'
COL_CROSSOVER = '#D62728'
BG_COLOR = '#FAFAFA'
GRID_COLOR = '#E0E0E0'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.labelsize': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': BG_COLOR,
    'axes.facecolor': '#FFFFFF',
    'axes.edgecolor': '#CCCCCC',
    'axes.grid': True,
    'grid.color': GRID_COLOR,
    'grid.linewidth': 0.5,
    'grid.alpha': 0.7,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 22))
fig.suptitle('The Renewable Energy Cost Revolution, 2010–2024',
             fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', y=0.975, color='#1a1a1a')
fig.text(0.5, 0.96,
         'Falling clean energy costs, surging capacity, and persistent fossil fuel subsidies',
         ha='center', fontsize=13, color='#555555', style='italic')

gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 2, hspace=0.35, wspace=0.28,
                      left=0.07, right=0.95, top=0.935, bottom=0.04)

# ============================================================
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])

fossil_gas_low_interp = np.interp(years_lcoe, years_fossil, gas_low)
fossil_gas_high_interp = np.interp(years_lcoe, years_fossil, gas_high)
fossil_coal_low_interp = np.interp(years_lcoe, years_fossil, coal_low)
fossil_coal_high_interp = np.interp(years_lcoe, years_fossil, coal_high)

fossil_band_low = np.minimum(fossil_gas_low_interp, fossil_coal_low_interp)
fossil_band_high = np.maximum(fossil_gas_high_interp, fossil_coal_high_interp)

ax1.fill_between(years_lcoe, fossil_band_low, fossil_band_high,

ax1.plot(years_lcoe, fossil_band_low, color=COL_COAL, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5, linestyle='--')
ax1.plot(years_lcoe, fossil_band_high, color=COL_COAL, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5, linestyle='--')

ax1.plot(years_lcoe, solar, color=COL_SOLAR, linewidth=2.8, marker='o', markersize=4,
         label=f'Solar PV  ($359 → $33)', zorder=3)
ax1.plot(years_lcoe, wind, color=COL_WIND, linewidth=2.8, marker='s', markersize=4,
         label=f'Onshore Wind  ($95 → $35)', zorder=3)

# Crossover annotations
# Solar crosses below fossil high around 2016-2017, below fossil low around 2018-2019
# Wind crosses below fossil high around 2015, below fossil low already near 2010
# More precise: solar < coal_high (~100) first in ~2016 at $86

ax1.scatter([2020], [41], color=COL_CROSSOVER, s=100, zorder=6, edgecolors='white', linewidth=1.5)
